_note: Illustrative scenario inputs, not forecasts. Every number marked 'assumption' is a choice to be validated; every number marked with an evidence id comes from evidence.json. Edit and rerun `python -m solutio_framework economics`.

government_fee_brl.why: Public bodies use the compliance layer free: no procurement process needed to adopt it.

verification_fee_brl_per_check.why: Paid by a financier before each financing decision.

take_rate_on_financed_volume.why: 35 bps per operation, shared with a licensed financing partner.

average_adhesion_obligations.why: One commitment note per executed adhesion.

close_accounts_after_settlement.why: Rent is a refundable deposit, but the program has no close instruction yet, so it is counted as cost.

scenarios.name: Pilot: one state central purchasing body
